description: This file contains shell script functions and configurations for initializing, configuring, and managing mac80211 wireless interfaces, including setup for hostapd, mesh, adhoc, and station modes, as well as capabilities and device configurations.

methods.name: iw
methods.description: Wrapper for the 'iw' command with error logging

methods.name: mac80211_add_capabilities
methods.description: Adds capabilities flags based on provided masks and capabilities

methods.name: mac80211_hostapd_setup_base
methods.description: Sets up base hostapd configuration for a given PHY

methods.name: mac80211_hostapd_setup_bss
methods.description: Configures a BSS (Basic Service Set) for hostapd

methods.name: mac80211_get_addr
methods.description: Retrieves the MAC address for a given PHY and index

methods.name: mac80211_generate_mac
methods.description: Generates a MAC address based on the PHY and address mask

methods.name: find_phy
methods.description: Finds the PHY device matching certain criteria

methods.name: mac80211_check_ap
methods.description: Checks if an access point interface exists

methods.name: mac80211_iw_interface_add
methods.description: Adds a new wireless interface using 'iw'

methods.name: mac80211_prepare_vif
methods.description: Prepares a virtual interface with specific mode and configuration

methods.name: get_freq
methods.description: Retrieves the frequency for a given PHY and channel

methods.name: chan_is_dfs
methods.description: Checks if a channel is DFS (radar detection) capable

methods.name: mac80211_interface_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up interfaces for a given PHY

methods.name: mac80211_set_noscan
methods.description: Sets the no-scan flag for hostapd

methods.name: drv_mac80211_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up the mac80211 driver setup

methods.name: drv_mac80211_setup
methods.description: Sets up the mac80211 wireless driver and interfaces
